name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) with Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) covers 'take the key, then open the door' and forces the key, so no Existence(has_door_key) is needed. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) is hard because 'After that' sits outside the 'try to' cue, and the soft Existence(target_picked_up) carries 'try to pick up'.

texts: Take the matching key before opening the door: door_open must not become true before has_door_key has become true.
Open the door: door_open must become true at least once during the episode.
After the door is open, the box in the other room comes next: target_picked_up must not become true before door_open has become true.
Try to pick up the box in the other room: target_picked_up is a soft goal, preferred but not required.
